release_notes: Reolink relaunched E1 Zoom as a 4K/8MP Wi-Fi 6 model (3840x2160), superseding the original 5MP (2560x1920) version this entry previously described. Field of view is not published for the current unit on reolink.com/product/e1-zoom/ (the prior '95-34 horizontal' figure could not be re-confirmed for the new hardware and has been removed rather than carried forward). Video codec is likewise not stated on the current product page and has been left unset.

frigate.notes: Detect width/height match the sub-stream (/Preview_01_sub), which on the E1 Zoom is locked at 640x480 — set these to your camera's actual sub-stream resolution so Frigate isn't resizing every frame. Frigate autotracking unsupported: Reolink uses absolute ONVIF PTZ; Frigate autotracking requires relative movement. Use the official /Preview_01_main path (Reolink RTSP KB); it serves the stream at the codec configured in the camera. The legacy /h264Preview_01_main path forces an H.264 re-encode and delivers noticeably lower quality on current firmware (community report, GitHub #280).

home_assistant.notes: Native Reolink integration auto-discovers via ONVIF on port 8000.

blue_iris.notes: Select 'Reolink' profile. If not listed, use Generic/ONVIF with RTSP path /Preview_01_main.

community_notes.note: For Reolink, the HTTP-FLV streams tend to be more reliable in Frigate than RTSP (which can stall / throw non-monotonic-timestamp errors); go2rtc can use the http source and add a secondary RTSP stream only for audio.
